title: Despicable
summary: DESPICABLE, adjective [Low Latin To look down, to despise; to look.] That may be or deserves to be despised; contemptible; mean; vile; worthless; applicable equally to persons and things; as a despica

inlines.v: DESPICABLE, adjective [Low Latin To look down, to despise; to look.] That may be or deserves to be despised; contemptible; mean; vile; worthless; applicable equally to persons and things; as a despicable man; despicable company; a despicable gift.
